notes.title: Report #06 : April 2025 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome, Inspectors.

Long time no see! We're still alive and kicking, and we’re bringing a lot of big (and hopefully good) news.

A bug a day keeps the dev away~

The first episode is still our main priority, but life is hard—and so is game development. We’ve encountered a lot of problems that naturally come with making a game.
But our team is working really hard to bring you the best version of Vanova’s Stories!

We also added a lot of juice to our various UI elements to give everything a bit more energy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/f5e49ceae61e863f3c8aa44d0836eb2a1c03c0cc.gif
Everything is better when it moves.

Testing the Second Investigation

The second investigation is done! But now we need to test it to make sure there’s nothing that could stop you from enjoying it.
Nothing major, but when working with a lot of elements, small issues can creep in—things you wouldn’t expect or even think were possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/bfee0c40bf70f0cee1869af39b46de27d9df4309.png
I mean, technically we are a small game… so it fits?


Cleaning the Third Investigation

All the graphic assets for the third and final investigation are done. Maps, characters, and clues—everything’s ready.
Now we just need to add a little bit of game developer magic to tie it all together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/ecf786c905b5c1a20cbabf76af7454891ab9ce56.png
Yes, this is a serious episode. Trust us.

Next Objective: Releasing the Game

Yes—finally! The game is coming out on the 12th of this month!

You’ll be able to play the first episode, and the next ones will arrive over the following months as free updates.

We’re so excited to finally show you the work we’ve done over the past few months. We hope you’re as interested as we are happy!

We’ll keep you updated on the progress of each part. Don’t hesitate to follow us on social media for exclusive images:

Twitter: https://x.com/VanovasStories

LinkedIn: https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio

Thank you so much for your patience and support. We can’t wait to show you what we’ve poured so much love into!

End of Report.

notes.title: Report #05 : December 2024 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome, Inspectors.

We are excited to welcome you at the start of this year, which promises many great things, the best of which is the release of the game (yes, really!).


Tutorial

The tutorial is complete. We are now in the debugging phase to ensure everything works smoothly for an upcoming demo. We’re waiting for the last issues to be resolved, like characters showing up where they shouldn't, before presenting it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/7d16bf8ece83ef9644eac46049281cd2913c5c6b.png
Beginnings are always humble.

Sound Implementation

We have started implementing the various music tracks and sounds sent to us by our partner. We’ve chosen to use a dynamic sound system. 
Each inspector will have their own instrument, which will blend into the music as soon as they enter the room.
It’s a metaphor for the idea that everyone brings their own energy, and together, we can create the most beautiful symphony. It’s poetic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/2bf1e00a85d3cbea09501b00dc2ea6fe4e045006.png
Yes, it’s a bit hard to convey sound through an image, but imagine a great tune.

Investigation 03

The first character sketches have been completed. We’re now in a more... serious environment? A good outfit is essential, though everyone manages to add their own... personal touch. Let’s say that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/f08f13deaf20cc90be5b1e847924a365ecf41490.png
Aren’t they serious?

The next goals will be:

- Finish the dialogues for Investigation 03
- Continue progress on Investigation 02
- Work on the missing graphic elements

We will keep you updated on the progress of these different elements. Don’t hesitate to follow us on our social media for exclusive images.

Twitter https://x.com/VanovasStories

LinkedIn https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio

We wish you a great start to the year and will be back next month with new updates!
Thank you for your support—we continue working to offer you the best experience possible!

End of Report.

notes.title: Report #04 : November 2024 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome, Inspectors.

In this snowless winter, we present the various advancements of Vanova's Stories.

Tutorial

The tutorial is almost complete. All the graphical assets and narrative elements have been created and implemented.
We’ve prepared everything to ensure our future inspectors are ready for action… Well, we hope so.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/811deb7269db2a60859967f29794d514699f6495.png
A list of responsibilities right from the start.

Investigation 02

The final designs of the characters have been completed, and their animations have been implemented.
The missing elements include the backgrounds for the investigation and the programming of new mechanics.
All of these will be added in the coming weeks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/1d14f3f19d50260f64e161fa532c0005a9ff7b3e.png
A new character with a peculiar detail. It’s up to you to figure out which one (Hint: He really likes its color).

Investigation 03

Pre-production for the final investigation has started. For now, we are focusing on the narrative and the various elements that make up the hypothesis.
All we can say is that the inspectors will face a foe of immense, immense proportions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/fae2b8459b242446861c61b3bd1a71034de9d493.png
The fun part of game balancing.

Our objectives for the month, amidst the various celebrations, are:

- Completion of the tutorial
- Progress on Investigation 02
- Writing the dialogues for Investigation 03

We will keep you updated on the progress of these different elements. Don’t hesitate to follow us on our social media for exclusive images.

Twitter https://x.com/VanovasStories

LinkedIn https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio

We wish you happy end-of-year holidays and hope to see you again in January!
Thank you for your support—we continue working to offer you the best experience possible!

End of Report.

notes.title: Report #03 : October 2024 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome, inspectors.

It's been a long time since we last saw each other! After some internal adjustments, we're back with even more progress.

Tutorial

The different steps and interactions have been decided. This version will be a mini-investigation in which players will have the challenging task of retrieving their equipment to set off on a mission. An exciting adventure awaits, I guess.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/7d392e39724511dce3439f54e4e11d3c2fcef4cc.png
A Sophisticated Working Environment

You’ll be in the police station and have the privilege of meeting your superior, Claire Adams. Her face may look familiar—she’s featured on all our materials but has never actually appeared in the story. That’s about to change! You’ll get to experience her delightful personality. Definitely not a misanthrope. Nope!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/a7cbbbd5cbf19c7026434d6efdafd0f00a14a802.png
Isn’t she charming?


 Puzzles - First Investigation 

We’ve worked hard on new cooperative elements, and they’re now fully functional! We’re continuing to incorporate the user feedback we’ve received, taking all comments into account—or at least the most relevant ones.

Some things can only be noticed by playing and trying to break the game (we love you, testers).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/b88e874553c39c6eddca7ca8205a4b8399b8cb97.png
Cooperation will be crucial.

 Puzzles - First Investigation 

As with the first investigation, inspectors will interact with a variety of, let’s say, quirky characters. From the very friendly Boris to the alluring Ingrid, these suspects hold important information for your investigation. We can’t wait for you to meet them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/3d33b203122534451d69be462afb422dd1723ee9.png
Some research about Ingrid. Yes, she’s indeed in the mountains.


No time to rest, as we’re moving into a new phase of research, including:

- Finalizing the environments for the second investigation
- Programming the puzzles for the second investigation
- Writing Investigation 03

We will keep you updated on the progress of these different elements. Feel free to follow us on our social media for exclusive images.

Twitter https://x.com/VanovasStories

Linkedin https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio


We wish you a good month of November and look forward to reconnecting in December before the year ends! 

Thank you for your support; we continue to work hard to offer you the best experience!

End of Report.

notes.title: Report #02 : July 2024 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome, inspectors.

We are happy to see you again in this new report. We have been working on many things during July and we can’t wait to tell you about them [strike]before heading to the beach.[/strike]

New Interactions in the first investigation

We are in the process of integrating new features into the first investigation. Cooperation will be more essential than ever. So we hope you get along well with your colleagues, or at least don't mind losing them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/d133f969a0324dcfe3c24ffe3e50e8e2830045d2.png
An inspector’s day is full of diverse and varied tasks.

We won’t show you more; you’ll discover them during your investigations!

 3D Search 

We have also recruited new talents to offer you the best possible version of the game. One of our current goals is to remaster the 3D searches with Vanova’s Stories' unique style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/347c2b85e040176f1e291a943f72e796686dc240.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/2f00e41bfc8e1991e53bddcb0905b0bc61e712de.png
Old Environments Get a Makeover

All these elements are works in progress. We can't wait for you to inspect them thoroughly.

August will be much calmer. We will see you again in September for the continuation of the development, specifically:

- Continuing to polish the existing elements.
- Integrating new mechanics into the first investigation.
- Beginning the concept art for the second investigation elements.


We will keep you updated on the progress of these different elements. Feel free to follow us on our social media for exclusive images.

Twitter https://x.com/VanovasStories

Linkedin https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio


We wish you a good month of August and hope to see you in September with more bearable weather. (We’re dying here.)

Thank you for your support; we continue to work hard to offer you the best experience!

End of Report.

notes.title: Repport #01 : June 2024 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome inspectors.

We're delighted to see you again. Despite the heat, we're making good progress. (but it's still hot as hell here).

Menus and Feedbacks

We've added feedbacks to liven up the dialogs. Given that you'll be reading (a lot), we're keen to keep them as lively as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/50c39d5d0ecca92235b98d573a8f1fcb84c2aa7b.gif

We also add animations to menus. Whether it's a map that appears or a new item obtained, each will have its own behavior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/1647a115e1ebeb608a62c0e9d7bee2c04d19f5b0.gif

We'll continue to add feedback to make the gameplay ever more satisfying.

Episode 02 dialogues

As well as adding juice to our various menus and dialogues, we're starting to work on the narrative and discussion trees for episode 02.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/54e05d79bb470e2e93c2a98e1f4a23717e5596a8.png
A glimpse of the new conversations, as serious as ever.

Our next objectives

- Continue polishing existing elements.
- Finish and edit the dialogues from episode 02.
- The start of concept art for the elements of episode 02.

We'll keep you posted on progress. Don't hesitate to follow us on our networks for exclusive images.

Twitter https://x.com/VanovasStories

Linkedin  https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio

Thank you for your support, we'll continue to work hard to bring you the best possible experience!

End of report
